## Exercise 5.1
```{r exercise5.1}
penguins %>% 
  pivot_longer(contains("_"),
               names_to = "variable_name",
               values_to = "value")

penguins_long <- penguins %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(contains("_"), # measurement cols
                      names_to = c("part", "measure", "unit"), 
                      names_sep = "_")

penguins_long
```
First variable in the penguins_long is the species variable

## Exercise 5.2
```{r exercise5.2}
penguins_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c("part", "measure", "unit"),
              values_from = c("value"),
              names_sep = "_")
```
What happened is that there are duplicates values and R doesn't know where to put them. By finding a way to identify the values and to which variable they belong they have to have a id
```{r exericise5.2_solved}
penguins_long <- penguins %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(contains("_"), # measurement cols
                      names_to = c("part", "measure", "unit"), 
                      names_sep = "_")

penguins_id <- penguins %>% mutate(id = seq(nrow(.)))
penguins_long_id <- penguins_id %>%
  pivot_longer(contains("_"),
                names_to = c("part", "measure", "unit"),
                names_sep = "_")

penguins_long_id %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c("part", "measure", "unit"),
              values_from = c("value"),
              names_sep = "_")
```

## Exercise 5.4
```{r exerise5.4}
food_preference <-
  tibble(
    penguin_species = c("Adelie", "Chinstrap", "Gentoo"),
    favorite_food = c("peanut butter", "cheese", "chocolate")
  )



left_join(penguins, food_preference, by = c("species" = "penguin_species"))
penguins
```
The key variables are the species variable in the penguin dataset and the penguin_species variable in the food_preference dataset. species is the primary key because that is the dataset we will be working in and penguin_species is the foreign key

## Exercise 5.10
create schema verfexperiment;

create table verfexperiment.rabbit (
	verfnummer int,
	oorkleur char(50),
	primary key (verfnummer)
);

create table verfexperiment.rat (
	verf int,
	staartkleur char(50),
	foreign key (verf) references verfexperiment.rabbit (verfnummer)
);
